visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a long grey wig, thick-framed glasses, and a patterned robe poses against a backdrop of white shelves filled with black binders. The person in the wig enters dramatically through the curtain. Another person with short black hair and small round glasses is lying in the bed, wearing a checkered shirt and a cream vest. A medical monitor is visible on a cart next to the bed. (3) The person in the wig approaches the person in the bed, speaking with animated facial expressions and hand movements. The person in the bed removes their glasses and reacts with surprise. (4) The scene shifts to the person with short hair now standing in a brightly lit room with a wooden dresser. They are wearing a large yellow banana-shaped headpiece over their head and a tropical shirt with a red sash. (5) Back in the room with the bed, the person in the banana headpiece sits at a wooden desk, slamming a stack of banknotes onto the surface. The person in the bed looks on. (6) A close-up shows a white credit card being held by a hand, making a heart gesture with fingers. Text overlays with financial details appear on the screen. (7) The person in the banana headpiece is shown in a metro train car, holding onto a silver handle. The interior of the train is white and blue. They tilt their head back as if the train is moving. (8) The final scene shows the person in the bed, wearing black eye covers, holding the white credit card and smiling at the camera.
